text: Given valid X-CW-* credential headers, when cw_list_agreement_types is called with no arguments, then the response is {items, count, page: 1, page_size: 25, has_more} sourced from GET /finance/agreements/types
Given conditions="inactiveFlag = false", when cw_list_agreement_types is called, then that exact string is sent as the conditions query parameter to ConnectWise
Given fields="id, name", when cw_list_agreement_types is called, then fields=id, name is sent to ConnectWise
Given orderBy="name asc", when cw_list_agreement_types is called, then orderBy=name asc is sent to ConnectWise and results are not re-sorted client-side
Given a mocked page with pageSize rows, when cw_list_agreement_types is called, then has_more is true; given page/pageSize omitted, then page defaults to 1 and page_size defaults to 25
Given a request missing or with a blank X-CW-* header, when any tool (including cw_list_agreement_types) is called, then the server returns 401 listing the expected headers
Given tools/list, then cw_list_agreement_types is present with a schema matching the other add_search list tools, and no pre-existing tool's name or schema changed from tools_baseline.json

Find the Tools table's Agreements row
